statements.t: We intend to use SDI to hold and operate digital infrastructure assets that we may acquire or develop in the future.
We cannot assure that we will acquire or develop any such assets, or as to the timing or terms of any such transactions.

The Company has applied to list its common stock on The Nasdaq Capital Market under the symbol “FCCN.” If the listing application is approved, the Company expects its common stock to be listed on Nasdaq upon consummation of the offering, at which point it will cease to be quoted on the OTCQB.

We intend to fund our operations through cash flows generated from our telecommunications subsidiaries, proceeds from our private placement offering approved in March 2026, the proposed underwritten public offering registered on our Registration Statement on Form S-1, and additional debt or equity financings as needed.

As of September 30, 2026, we had cash and cash equivalents of $4,721 and a working capital deficit of $27,013, or $9,142 excluding contingent consideration of $17,871 that is expected to be settled through the issuance of shares of our common stock and does not represent a cash funding requirement.

We expect to fund our operations through cash flows from our telecommunications subsidiaries, borrowings under our receivables financing arrangement with Fasanara Securitisation S.A., proceeds from our private placement offering, the working capital advance made by our Chief Executive Officer in July 2026, and additional equity or debt financing, including through our proposed underwritten public offering.
We will require additional financing to fund our operations and execute our growth strategy, including in connection with the proposed Intermatica transaction and our planned Nasdaq uplisting.

There can be no assurance that additional financing will be available on acceptable terms or at all, that our Registration Statement on Form S-1 will be declared effective, or that the proposed underwritten public offering will be completed.

estimates.t: There have been no material changes to our critical accounting policies and estimates as disclosed in our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025, except as described below.

estimates.name: Fair Value of Contingent Consideration
estimates.t: The most significant critical accounting estimate relates to the fair value measurement of contingent consideration liabilities associated with the acquisitions of 42 Telecom and TVS.
